description: This file defines a JavaScript module 'selectOptionsEditor' that manages select options UI components, including initialization, modal handling, drag-and-drop reordering, and dynamic input visibility. It also sets up event listeners for DOM content loaded to initialize select options editors on page load.

methods.name: initilize
methods.description: Initializes the select options editor with given element ID, options data, and default value.

methods.name: initilizeElement
methods.description: Initializes the editor for a specific DOM element by ID, options, and value.

methods.name: initilizeFieldType
methods.description: Sets up change event listeners on select menus to toggle visibility of input containers based on selected value.
